DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", task_type_id as "taskTypeId", task_type_param_id as "taskTypeParamId", incident_type_task_id as "incidentTypeTaskId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_task_values (incident_report_id, task_type_id, task_type_param_id, incident_type_task_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId, :taskTypeId, :taskTypeParamId, :incidentTypeTaskId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_report_task_values SET value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND task_type_id = :taskTypeId AND task_type_param_id = :taskTypeParamId AND incident_type_task_id = :incidentTypeTaskId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_values WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND task_type_id = :taskTypeId AND task_type_param_id = :taskTypeParamId AND incident_type_task_id = :incidentTypeTaskId
